title: mut.channel_anadol_living_archive_coral
mutation_directive: Refik Anadol — Echoes of the Earth: Living Archive — Echoes of the Earth: Living Archive (Serpentine, 2024); Large Nature Model collaboration with Smithsonian/Google DeepMind. VISUAL SIGNATURE: AI-hallucinated coral reefs and rainforest canopies: looping, dreamlike biological textures that morph between species — fern fronds become coral polyps become moss. Saturated turquoise/coral/lime; wet-looking organic surfaces; the flicker of AI latent-space interpolation between training images. TECHNICAL HOOKS for three.js / GLSL: NOT another data flow ribbon. Instead: a parametric reef of instanced procedural coral primitives (tube, branching, plate, brain) on a substrate plane; each instance morphs its species-parameters via slow Perlin-noise drift through a 4D 'species latent space'. Per-instance subsurface-scattering shader gives wet coral feel. Particles drift in front (plankton). Audio-reactive: a slow underwater hum modulates the morph rate. Palette: turquoise water, coral pink, lime kelp. WHY DIVERSE: Pool has 'Refik-style data flows' but THIS is the post-LLM Anadol — the Large Nature Model, biological-latent-space register. Different from his ribbon work. Stay faithful to the visual signature; pick whatever three.js primitives are needed (Lines2 / InstancedMesh / SphereGeometry / custom ShaderMaterial) — but the FORM should read as if this artist made it. REF: https://www.serpentinegalleries.org/whats-on/refik-anadol-echoes-of-the-earth-living-archive/
